semiconductor_relevance: High — CE-MAT GmbH provides specialized equipment and components crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CE-MAT GmbH specializes in providing innovative and cost-effective products for the semiconductor industry, focusing on equipment and components such as Ceramic Spray Electrostatic Chucks, consumables for plasma etching, and quartz parts for CVD and epitaxy processes. The company also acts as a sales representative for Asian and European companies, enhancing its role in the semiconductor value chain.
capabilities: Consumables for Single Wafer Plasma Etch
Quartz parts for furnaces and epitaxy processes
Second source parts for ion implanters

regional_presence.Europe: CE-MAT acts as a sales representative for various Asian companies in Europe.
regional_presence.Asia: CE-MAT represents European companies in Asia, facilitating cross-regional business.
